extracts.lead_summary: XLK closed the week at $183.23, down 0.13%, which hides a 3.3% Thursday that took it to $182.34, under last Friday's low close. Lam Research reported a record quarter Wednesday night (revenue $8.22B, +54% y/y, a 40.2% operating margin) and fell 11.8% Thursday on a December guide of $8.6B ±$400M that the market read as a ceiling; AMAT fell 8.2% in sympathy. The same morning Meta raised its capex forecast and the AI trade sold: SMH -6.0% on the day, -2.3% on the week to its lowest close since Jul 29. Eight of the top ten fell. AAPL set a two-year closing high of $348.22 Thursday and PLTR rose 5.8%. The 10-year closed under 5.00% Thursday and Friday for the first time since Sep 22, October hike odds collapsed to under 10%, and the fund still could not hold its 50D. VIX 19.45.
